description: Synthetic fixed observations for search-ground.jpp (construction check only; not model evaluation; B184). Generations are fixed; exec_sql runs the SQL for real only when the seed ledger is recorded (see 地基/过程记录/工程-步25e.md), and the golden resumes from that seed without executing anything. Round 0: c0 (no quarter filter, wrong scope) is judged and rejected; c1 (typo'd column name -> SQL error) is code-excluded by opts.keep before any judgment call; c2 (quarter filter off by one day, missing 2026-06-30) lands in-band and is refined into round 1's context together with the code-excluded c1 (both are carried forward under unsure_to: refine). Round 1: c3 (correct quarter + correct grouping) is accepted, reaching width 1 and stopping; c4 (filter on a nonexistent category -> empty result) is code-excluded by opts.keep; c5 (correct quarter but grouped by product, wrong grain) is judged and rejected. The calibration record is hand-written to exercise routing, not a real authentication.
